summary: Unconditional physics-state initializer: clears the change-flag byte at this+0x19A4, sets the activation-flag byte at this+0x0 to 1, writes a float value a3 into an indexed float slot at byte offset 4*a2+7336, then triggers pressure/force-field remapping for the vehicle state.

local_names.a2: index selecting the float slot to write
local_names.a3: float value stored into the indexed slot

operations.description: Clear change-flag byte at this+0x19A4 to 0.
Set activation-flag byte at this+0x0 to 1.
Write float a3 to the indexed float slot at byte offset 4*a2+7336 of the state array.
Call PressureForceFieldMapping on this to recompute pressure/force fields from the updated state.
